grant_policy: Writing only. First total level class package plus background package; multiclass entry grants no starting equipment. Preserve original options/GP; never merge mutually exclusive options. Links to candidates do not resolve production acquisition.

source_entry.note: No loaded generic Book item; topic 'prayers' must be represented (SRD p.96 Book bonus depends on topic).

SRD p.97: a Holy Symbol takes one of the forms in the Holy Symbols table (Amulet, Emblem, Reliquary). Background does not name a form; loaded generic holy_symbol vs amulet/emblem/reliquary must be reconciled.
No loaded Parchment item (SRD p.95/99, 1 SP per sheet).
